INSERT INTO platform_call_minute (bucket_start,mode,api_key,application_key,tenant_key,employee_key,identity_kind,governance_rejected,observed_requests,rule_hits,ip_denied,token_bucket_rejected,daily_quota_rejected,requests,successes,client_errors,server_errors, auth_rejected,rate_limited,slow_calls,unattributed,duration_sum,max_duration) VALUES (#{minute},#{record.mode},COALESCE(#{record.apiId},''),COALESCE(#{record.applicationId},''),COALESCE(#{record.tenantId},''),COALESCE(#{record.employeeId},''),#{record.identityKind},
CASE WHEN #{record.governance.allowed}=false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.governance.observed}=true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,#{record.governance.violationCount}, CASE WHEN #{record.governance.allowed}=false AND #{record.governance.denialReason}='IP_DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.governance.allowed}=false AND #{record.governance.denialReason}='TOKEN_BUCKET_LIMIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.governance.allowed}=false AND #{record.governance.denialReason}='DAILY_QUOTA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0,0,0,0,0,0,1, CASE WHEN #{record.outcome}='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.httpStatus} BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.httpStatus} BETWEEN 500 AND 599 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.httpStatus} IN (401,403) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.httpStatus}=429 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.durationMillis} >= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{record.apiId},'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{record.durationMillis},#{record.durationMillis}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE governance_rejected=governance_rejected+VALUES(governance_rejected), observed_requests=observed_requests+VALUES(observed_requests),rule_hits=rule_hits+VALUES(rule_hits), ip_denied=ip_denied+VALUES(ip_denied),token_bucket_rejected=token_bucket_rejected+VALUES(token_bucket_rejected), daily_quota_rejected=daily_quota_rejected+VALUES(daily_quota_rejected),requests=requests+1,successes=successes+VALUES(successes), client_errors=client_errors+VALUES(client_errors),server_errors=server_errors+VALUES(server_errors), auth_rejected=auth_rejected+VALUES(auth_rejected),rate_limited=rate_limited+VALUES(rate_limited), slow_calls=slow_calls+VALUES(slow_calls),unattributed=unattributed+VALUES(unattributed), duration_sum=duration_sum+VALUES(duration_sum),max_duration=GREATEST(max_duration,VALUES(max_duration))

INSERT INTO platform_rule_minute (rule_id,rule_version,bucket_start,mode,api_key,application_key,tenant_key,employee_key,identity_kind,governance_rejected,observed_requests,rule_hits,ip_denied,token_bucket_rejected,daily_quota_rejected,requests,successes,client_errors,server_errors, auth_rejected,rate_limited,slow_calls,unattributed,duration_sum,max_duration) VALUES (#{hit.ruleId},#{hit.version},#{minute},#{record.mode},COALESCE(#{record.apiId},''),COALESCE(#{record.applicationId},''),COALESCE(#{record.tenantId},''),COALESCE(#{record.employeeId},''),#{record.identityKind}, CASE WHEN #{record.governance.allowed}=false AND #{hit.mode}='ENFORCE' AND #{hit.reason}!='NONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{hit.mode}='OBSERVE' AND #{hit.reason}!='NONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{hit.reason}!='NONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.governance.allowed}=false AND #{hit.mode}='ENFORCE' AND #{hit.reason}='IP_DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.governance.allowed}=false AND #{hit.mode}='ENFORCE' AND #{hit.reason}='TOKEN_BUCKET_LIMIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.governance.allowed}=false AND #{hit.mode}='ENFORCE' AND #{hit.reason}='DAILY_QUOTA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,1,
CASE WHEN #{record.outcome}='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.httpStatus} BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.httpStatus} BETWEEN 500 AND 599 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.httpStatus} IN (401,403) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.httpStatus}=429 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{record.durationMillis} >= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{record.apiId},'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{record.durationMillis},#{record.durationMillis}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE governance_rejected=governance_rejected+VALUES(governance_rejected), observed_requests=observed_requests+VALUES(observed_requests),rule_hits=rule_hits+VALUES(rule_hits), ip_denied=ip_denied+VALUES(ip_denied),token_bucket_rejected=token_bucket_rejected+VALUES(token_bucket_rejected), daily_quota_rejected=daily_quota_rejected+VALUES(daily_quota_rejected),requests=requests+1,successes=successes+VALUES(successes), client_errors=client_errors+VALUES(client_errors),server_errors=server_errors+VALUES(server_errors), auth_rejected=auth_rejected+VALUES(auth_rejected),rate_limited=rate_limited+VALUES(rate_limited), slow_calls=slow_calls+VALUES(slow_calls),unattributed=unattributed+VALUES(unattributed), duration_sum=duration_sum+VALUES(duration_sum),max_duration=GREATEST(max_duration,VALUES(max_duration))
mapper.sql: COALESCE(SUM(governance_rejected),0) AS governance_rejected,COALESCE(SUM(observed_requests),0) AS observed_requests, COALESCE(SUM(rule_hits),0) AS rule_hits,COALESCE(SUM(ip_denied),0) AS ip_denied, COALESCE(SUM(token_bucket_rejected),0) AS token_bucket_rejected,COALESCE(SUM(daily_quota_rejected),0) AS daily_quota_rejected, COALESCE(SUM(requests),0) AS requests,COALESCE(SUM(successes),0) AS successes, COALESCE(SUM(client_errors),0) AS client_errors,COALESCE(SUM(server_errors),0) AS server_errors, COALESCE(SUM(auth_rejected),0) AS auth_rejected,COALESCE(SUM(rate_limited),0) AS rate_limited, COALESCE(SUM(slow_calls),0) AS slow_calls,COALESCE(SUM(unattributed),0) AS unattributed, COALESCE(SUM(duration_sum),0) AS duration_sum,COALESCE(MAX(max_duration),0) AS max_duration
mapper.select: SELECT grouped_bucket AS bucket_start, FROM (SELECT FLOOR(bucket_start / CAST(#{minutes} AS DECIMAL(10,0))) * #{minutes} AS grouped_bucket, governance_rejected,observed_requests,rule_hits,ip_denied,token_bucket_rejected,daily_quota_rejected,requests,successes,client_errors,server_errors,auth_rejected,rate_limited,slow_calls, unattributed,duration_sum,max_duration ) buckets GROUP BY grouped_bucket ORDER BY grouped_bucket

SELECT grouped_bucket AS bucket_start, FROM (SELECT FLOOR(bucket_start / CAST(#{q.bucket.minutes} AS DECIMAL(10,0))) * #{q.bucket.minutes} AS grouped_bucket, governance_rejected,observed_requests,rule_hits,ip_denied,token_bucket_rejected,daily_quota_rejected, requests,successes,client_errors,server_errors,auth_rejected,rate_limited,slow_calls,unattributed,duration_sum,max_duration ) buckets GROUP BY grouped_bucket ORDER BY grouped_bucket

SELECT r.*, COALESCE(p.display_name,c.name) AS name,p.employee_no,p.tenant_name FROM ( SELECT tenant_key AS tenant_id,employee_key AS employee_id,identity_kind,'' AS api_id, '' AS tenant_id,'' AS employee_id,'UNKNOWN' AS identity_kind,api_key AS api_id, tenant_key AS tenant_id,'' AS employee_id,'UNKNOWN' AS identity_kind,'' AS api_id,
GROUP BY tenant_key,employee_key,identity_kindapi_keytenant_key HAVING SUM(rule_hits) > 0 ORDER BY (SUM(requests)-SUM(successes))SUM(governance_rejected)SUM(rule_hits)SUM(requests) DESC, tenant_key,employee_key,identity_kindapi_keytenant_key LIMIT #{q.top} ) r LEFT JOIN access_employee_profile p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.employee_id=r.employee_id AND r.identity_kind='EMPLOYEE' LEFT JOIN catalog_api_draft c ON c.id=r.api_id ORDER BY (r.requests-r.successes)r.governance_rejectedr.rule_hitsr.requests DESC,r.tenant_id,r.employee_id,r.api_id
